title: Etale origin and bounded models for compactification projection comparison
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, an integer $n\ge1$, and $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X,Y$ be finite-type $k$-schemes and $f:X\to Y$ a separated finite-type $k$-morphism. Fix a factorization $c=(j,r)$ with $j:X\hookrightarrow Z$ open, $r:Z\to Y$ proper and $rj=f$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-open-immersion]. Use ordinary constant-$A$ module derived categories on the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], and put $A_T=\nu_T^*$ for exact derived comparison [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback].

Let $K\in D^b(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ and $L\in D^b(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ have intrinsically constructible cohomology [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf]. Fix integers $c_0\le d_0$ and $a\le b$ such that $K,L$ have pro-etale Tor amplitude in $[c_0,d_0]$ and $[a,b]$, respectively [def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude]. There exist bounded constructible etale objects $K_0,L_0$ [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes] and origin witnesses $e_K:A_XK_0\cong K$, $e_L:A_YL_0\cong L$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness], with etale Tor amplitudes in these same respective intervals [def-kun-tor-amplitude]. The following model assertions hold for every such pair of representatives and witnesses, including witnesses supplied in advance.

For every $u\le v$ with $\mathcal H^i(K_0)=0$ outside $[u,v]$, there are a cochain complex $C^\bullet$ representing $K_0$, zero outside $[u,v]$, and a cochain complex $P^\bullet$ representing $L_0$, flat and zero outside $[a,b]$. Flat means that tensoring with a term is exact; K-flat means that total tensor with any acyclic complex is acyclic [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules, def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules, def-pc-kflat-complex]. Both $P^\bullet$ and its termwise inverse image $r_e^*P^\bullet$ are K-flat, and the latter represents $Lr_e^*L_0$. Exact open extension $j_!^e$ [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero] makes $j_!^eC^\bullet$ a model of $M_0=j_!^eK_0$ supported in $[u,v]$. The signed total tensor complex [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]
$$\operatorname{Tot}(j_!^eC^\bullet\otimes_A r_e^*P^\bullet)^m=\bigoplus_{i+h=m}j_!^eC^i\otimes_A r_e^*P^h,$$
with differential $d_C\otimes1+(-1)^i1\otimes d_P$ on bidegree $(i,h)$, represents $Q_0=M_0\otimes_A^L Lr_e^*L_0$ [def-kun-derived-tensor] and is zero outside $[u+a,v+b]$. Thus $M_0,Q_0$ are bounded below. The morphism $r$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated (its diagonal is quasi-compact), so these are admissible inputs for the canonical bounded-below direct-image comparison mate. All sites are chosen small in one common larger universe.

proof.text: For each cohomology sheaf of K and L, keep the intrinsic finite stratification and apply [lem-sf-proetale-lisse-finite-models] on every stratum. This gives the finite constant models in the source fixed-module constructibility predicate. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-fixed-module-constructible-origin] to these sheaves and then [lem-weil-pbc-fixed-module-bounded-constructible-origin] to each bounded complex. Convert the source etale constructibility predicate by [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-etale-module-sheaf-comparison]. The source lower cohomology bound packages each antecedent as a fixed D+ origin witness, with its displayed comparison isomorphism. This proves existence without any choice of data in a definition.

proof.text: For every supplied pair of fixed etale-origin witnesses, transport the pro-etale categorical Tor-amplitude property through its specified isomorphism. Apply the fixed-module form of [lem-exc-comparison-tor-interval], namely the existing source theorem ProEtale.DerivedCategory.torAmplitudeIn_mapDerivedCategory_iff, and the existing hasTorAmplitudeIn_iff_torAmplitudeIn. This gives exactly [c_0,d_0] and [a,b] for the original antecedents. The fixed-coefficient HasFixedCoefficientProEtaleTorAmplitude already contains the categorical Tor test, so no intrinsic ringed coefficient realization is necessary.

Turn the cohomology vanishing of K_0 outside [u,v] into IsGE u and IsLE v, and apply [lem-sfb-bounded-representative] to obtain C with strict support [u,v] and Q(C) isomorphic to K_0. This includes a singleton interval and an acyclic object.

Convert the etale Tor test of L_0 to categorical torAmplitudeIn. Apply [lem-sc-source-tor-amplitude-flat-model] directly in ordinary module-valued etale sheaves to obtain a flat-term representative P strictly supported in [a,b] with Q(P) isomorphic to L_0. This generic source theorem uses precisely the tensor of [def-kun-derived-tensor]; no comparison between separately constructed derived tensors is involved. Flatness includes exactness of tensorRight. Apply [lem-sfb-bounded-above-flat-kflat] to P.

source.place: exists_iso_Q_obj_flat_of_torAmplitudeIn, lines 260-300; Stacks sites-cohomology.tex Tag 08G1, lemma-tor-amplitude.

proof.text: Let RP be the literal termwise inverse image of P along r. The source upperStarPreservesFlat_moduleCat instance, in the module of [lem-sfb-etale-flat-geometric-fibers], makes each term flat. Additive inverse image preserves the zero terms, hence RP has strict support [a,b]. Apply [lem-sfb-bounded-above-flat-kflat] again to obtain K-flatness of RP. Exact inverse image and [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization], composed with the image of Q(P) isomorphic to L_0, give Q(RP) isomorphic to the prescribed derived pullback of L_0. No flatness of the scheme morphism is used.

Put JC=j!C. By [lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-exact], extension by zero is exact, so [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization] and the representing isomorphism of C give Q(JC) isomorphic to M_0. Additivity preserves the zero terms, so JC has strict support [u,v]. The lower support bound also gives bounded-below membership of M_0.

source.place: Tag 03DJ, lemma-extension-by-zero-exact; source openImmersionLowerShriek and mapDerivedCategoryFactors.

proof.text: The existing source DerivedCategory.QObjTensorQObjIsoOfKFlatRight applied to JC and RP identifies Q(Tot(JC tensor RP)) with Q(JC) tensor-derived Q(RP). Compose with tensorIso of the two representing isomorphisms to obtain the exact object Q_0 of [def-kun-derived-tensor]. The signed total tensor of [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] has strict support [u+a,v+b], by the source isStrictlyGE_tensorObj and isStrictlyLE_tensorObj lemmas: a nonzero summand requires u<=i<=v, a<=h<=b, and i+h=m. Localization and the representing isomorphism give bounded-below membership of Q_0.

proof.text: Properness of r [def-weil-proper-morphism] gives quasi-compactness; its separatedness gives quasi-separatedness by [lem-pc-separated-quasi-separated]. Pair these with the models and lower bounds already established. The theorem asserts admissibility only, so no direct-image comparison theorem is invoked.
